+import csv
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+con = duckdb.connect()
+
+for plan_id in (1, 2, 3):
+    plan = json.loads((OUT / f"plan_{plan_id}.json").read_text())
+    outcome_cols = (
+        ["number_of_pedestrians_injured", "number_of_pedestrians_killed"]
+        if plan_id in (1, 3)
+        else ["number_of_pedestrians_killed"]
+    )
+    facts = []
+
+    def fact(name, value):
+        facts.append((name, value))
+
+    # The plan window is all available calendar years beginning in 2013.
+    total = con.execute(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'",
+        [str(DATA)],
+    ).fetchone()[0]
+    brooklyn_total = con.execute(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND lower(trim(coalesce(borough, ''))) = 'brooklyn'",
+        [str(DATA)],
+    ).fetchone()[0]
+    fact("all_city_rows_in_plan_years_2013_onward", total)
+    fact("brooklyn_rows_in_plan_years_before_outcome_validity_filter", brooklyn_total)
+
+    # Filter-column quality is checked before borough filtering, on all rows in
+    # the plan's calendar-year window. Missing/unknown and impossible boroughs
+    # are distinguished from ordinary non-Brooklyn borough values.
+    borough_quality = con.execute(
+        """
+        SELECT
+          count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough IS NULL OR trim(borough) = '' OR lower(trim(borough)) IN ('unknown','unspecified','n/a','na','null')),
+          count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND trim(borough) <> '' AND lower(trim(borough)) NOT IN ('bronx','brooklyn','manhattan','queens','staten island','unknown','unspecified','n/a','na','null'))
+        FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+        """,
+        [str(DATA)],
+    ).fetchone()
+    fact("borough_missing_or_unknown_rows_before_borough_filter_in_plan_years", borough_quality[0])
+    fact("borough_impossible_value_rows_before_borough_filter_in_plan_years", borough_quality[1])
+
+    # Date quality and partial-year coverage are assessed only within the plan
+    # window; crash_date is DATE-typed, so impossible non-null values cannot occur.
+    null_dates = con.execute(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date IS NULL",
+        [str(DATA)],
+    ).fetchone()[0]
+    fact("null_crash_date_rows_in_file_cannot_be_assigned_to_a_plan_year", null_dates)
+
+    year_rows = con.execute(
+        """
+        SELECT year(crash_date) AS yr, count(*) AS city_rows,
+               count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(borough,'')))='brooklyn') AS brooklyn_rows,
+               min(crash_date) AS first_date, max(crash_date) AS last_date
+        FROM read_parquet(?)
+        WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+        GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
+        """,
+        [str(DATA)],
+    ).fetchall()
+    for year, city_n, bk_n, first_date, last_date in year_rows:
+        fact(f"year_{year}_all_city_rows", city_n)
+        fact(f"year_{year}_brooklyn_rows_before_outcome_validity_filter", bk_n)
+        is_partial = first_date.month > 1 or first_date.day > 1 or last_date.month < 12 or last_date.day < 31
+        fact(f"year_{year}_coverage", f"partial ({first_date} through {last_date})" if is_partial else f"full calendar year ({first_date} through {last_date})")
+
+    for col in outcome_cols:
+        result = con.execute(
+            f"SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE {col} IS NULL) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND lower(trim(coalesce(borough,'')))='brooklyn'",
+            [str(DATA)],
+        ).fetchone()[0]
+        fact(f"{col}_missing_rows_in_brooklyn_population_and_plan_years", result)
+
+    # For the crash-share framing, count denominator records after excluding
+    # records with missing pedestrian outcome fields; do not inspect outcomes.
+    if plan_id == 3:
+        for year, *_ in year_rows:
+            usable = con.execute(
+                """
+                SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(?)
+                WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND year(crash_date)=?
+                  AND lower(trim(coalesce(borough,'')))='brooklyn'
+                  AND number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NOT NULL
+                  AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NOT NULL
+                """,
+                [str(DATA), year],
+            ).fetchone()[0]
+            fact(f"year_{year}_plan_3_valid_denominator_crash_rows", usable)
+
+    with (OUT / f"check_{plan_id}.csv").open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writerows(facts)
*** End Patch

+import csv

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib
+

+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import matplotlib.ticker as mtick
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+NAVY = "#17324d"
+TEAL = "#078b87"
+CORAL = "#dc6655"
+GRAY = "#687985"
+con = duckdb.connect()
+
+rows = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_injured) AS pedestrian_injuries,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_deaths,
+           count(*) AS brooklyn_crash_rows,

+             AS crashes_with_pedestrian_casualty
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(borough,''))) = 'brooklyn'
+      AND crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+      AND number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NOT NULL
+      AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [str(DATA)],
+).fetchall()
+
+years = [r[0] for r in rows]
+injuries = [int(r[1]) for r in rows]
+deaths = [int(r[2]) for r in rows]
+crash_rows = [int(r[3]) for r in rows]
+casualty_crashes = [int(r[4]) for r in rows]
+casualties = [a + b for a, b in zip(injuries, deaths)]
+shares = [100 * n / d for n, d in zip(casualty_crashes, crash_rows)]
+
+
+def style_axis(ax):
+    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#cad3d8")
+    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#cad3d8")
+    ax.tick_params(colors=GRAY, labelsize=9)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#e5eaed", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.set_xticks(years)
+    ax.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], rotation=45, ha="right")
+
+
+def save_values(option_id, headers, value_rows):
+    with (OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv").open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(headers)
+        writer.writerows(value_rows)
+
+
+def plot(option_id, title, subtitle, metric_label, values, color, chart_type="line", percent=False):
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 5.9), dpi=170)
+    fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
+    ax.set_facecolor("white")
+    if chart_type == "bar":
+        ax.bar(years, values, color=CORAL, width=0.72)
+    else:
+        ax.plot(years, values, color=color, linewidth=2.8, marker="o", markersize=5.2,

+        ax.scatter([years[-1]], [values[-1]], color=color, s=42, zorder=4)
+    style_axis(ax)
+    if percent:
+        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mtick.PercentFormatter(xmax=100, decimals=0))
+    ax.set_ylabel(metric_label, fontsize=10, color=NAVY, labelpad=10)
+    ax.set_xlabel("Crash year", fontsize=10, color=NAVY, labelpad=8)
+    fig.suptitle(title, x=0.09, y=0.97, ha="left", fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", color=NAVY)
+    fig.text(0.09, 0.91, subtitle, ha="left", fontsize=9.4, color=GRAY)
+    fig.text(0.09, 0.025, "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crash records. Complete calendar years only.",

+    plt.close(fig)
+
+

+    assert plan["years"] == "Complete calendar years 2013 through 2025; exclude 2026 because coverage ends 2026-06-11"
+
+save_values(1,
+            ["year", "pedestrian_injuries", "pedestrian_deaths", "pedestrian_casualties", "brooklyn_crash_rows"],
+            zip(years, injuries, deaths, casualties, crash_rows))
+plot(1,
+     "Pedestrian casualties in Brooklyn crashes, 2013–2025",
+     "Injured + killed pedestrians per year; counts from police-reported crashes, not adjusted for walking exposure.",
+     "Pedestrian casualties", casualties, TEAL)
+
+save_values(2,
+            ["year", "pedestrians_killed", "brooklyn_crash_rows"],
+            zip(years, deaths, crash_rows))
+plot(2,
+     "Pedestrians killed in Brooklyn crashes, 2013–2025",
+     "Annual fatalities in police-reported crashes; counts do not measure risk per pedestrian trip.",
+     "Pedestrians killed", deaths, CORAL, chart_type="bar")
+
+save_values(3,
+            ["year", "crashes_with_pedestrian_casualty", "brooklyn_crash_rows", "share_percent"],
+            zip(years, casualty_crashes, crash_rows, shares))
+plot(3,
+     "Brooklyn crashes involving pedestrian casualties, 2013–2025",
+     "Share of crash reports with ≥1 pedestrian injured or killed; denominator is all Brooklyn crash reports.",
+     "Share of Brooklyn crash reports", shares, NAVY, percent=True)
